Oneliner

World's First Educational Multispectral Cubesat Build by High-School Students
Description

Educational multi-spectral Cubesat developed by the cooperation between Bangkok Christian College and the King’s Mongkut university of technology north Bangkok.

  • Capture images with 4 cameras from different filters for Earth’s observation; Red, Green, Blue, and NIR.
  • Send the Slow Scan Digital Video to Earth via HAM

The images from these cameras will be used to process for the Normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI), that will significantly provides huge advantage on analyzing the terrain of the country.
